verdict.rationale: The Florida Department of Revenue is a state tax agency whose filing and payment portals hold taxpayer records under state authority. Letting a taxpayer pick a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of government service, not a capability a comparable product would plausibly ship. Nothing in the evidence (reemployment tax eFile/ePay, batch enrollment, login shells) suggests otherwise.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
